svg.title: S10_palette_assessment
svg.desc: Severe-condition colour-vision stress test using Machado matrices in linear sRGB, clipping and re-encoding for display. Tritan is an approximation, not a validated simulation of individual tritanopia. Some category colours converge: labels, abbreviations and domain placement are mandatory. This is not a claim of universal 17-colour accessibility. Source: https://colour.readthedocs.io/en/develop/_modules/colour/blindness/machado2009.html
